title: App Studio 改版（follow-up of 1-5）：只读软件包里，资源列表的「新建」按钮置灰并带提示
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbL6Nn3scsU8yvLyU4

Filing gate: ③ · Source: card #37456 (half 1, PR #37579, head 892cd557). Its acceptance notes name this case, and `ResourceListPage.tsx` sits outside that card's claimed surface, so it is filed here rather than widened there. Sub-issue of #37456.
Grade: area:ux · Feature · p2 · evidence: on a read-only package, #37456 draws a lock in the top-left rows, but the resource list's New button stays enabled.
Reader: area `ux-37424`.

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：打开一个只读（系统自带）软件包时，资源列表页的「新建」按钮变灰，鼠标悬停说明原因：这个包是只读的。
- 为什么：左上角已经显示锁，但「新建」还能点，点了才被拒，前后不一致。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What

- In `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/**` `ResourceListPage.tsx`, read the same read-only signal #37456 uses for the lock (`publishReadOnly` / the package's read-only posture). Do not derive a second rule.
- When the package is read-only, render New as disabled, with a tooltip that reuses `engine.studio.pkg.readonlyHint` (or one new en+zh key if the copy must differ).
- Writable packages are unchanged.

## Acceptance

- On a read-only package, New is disabled and its tooltip names the reason (tested, with an ablation that goes red).
- On a writable package, New works as today (tested).
- Light and dark screenshots attached.
